rules.statement: The deed in question includes specific references that indicate the donor has renounced the right to revoke the gift.
rules.supporting_quote: i) In the deed in question the right to revoke has been renounced by the donor - ii) The operative words embodied specifically refer to section 5(1 )(d) of the Ordinance, No. 39 of 1938, in renouncing his right to revoke. No other 142 meaning could be attributed to the aforesaid operative words. Reference to section 5(1 )(d) makes it clear what the intention of the donor is. iii) It is also seen that the Notary who attested the deed acknowledge the fact that before the parties signed the deed that he read over and explained the contents of the deed to them
